Rules-Game Settings:
🔁 Infinites (Restricted)
Infinites are NOT allowed to loop continuously.
Players may perform ONE repetition ONLY, followed by a combo ender.

Examples:
● Crazy Legs 5PP [BC] 5PP
● Bless 6PPP [BC] 6PPP
● Joe Budden 5PP [BC] 5PP

🚫 Banned Stages and Infinite Locations
The following stages are banned:
● Gun Hill Garage
● Inferno
● 125 street station
● Terror Dome

Infinites performed in the following areas are strictly banned:
● Boxing Rings
● Flood Lights
● Empty Stage Areas
● Roll-Off-The-Wall Situations
● Wall Re-Dizzy
⚠ Violation will result in forfeit of the round.

Starting Stage
All players will start on Club Murder for the 1st Stage. After Each match, the loser picks the next stage.

Dave's Stupid Rule
● If both players win on the same stage, stages must be switched

Character Select Rules
Before a Set:
● Players may request a coin toss
● If no request is made, characters are picked normally

After Each Match:
● Loser picks first
● Winner is character-locked, IF their previous character is still available
● If the loser selects the winner’s previous character:
○ The winner may choose a new character

🤼 Grapple Limit Rule
Grapple moves that ignore the double down stun limit are restricted to 1 per combo.
Exceptions:
● Blazin’ Moves
● Wall Grapples

🧱 Wall Mechanics / Touch of Death
Clarification
To maintain fair play, the following rules apply:

❌ BANNED (Touch of Death)
Deliberately ending a combo to leave your opponent:
● Standing Stunned
● Locked in a Wall Re-Dizzy state

✅ ALLOWED
The following are legal interactions:
● Momentum Stuns
● Opponent is knocked down by a combo ender
● Opponent falls out of a combo naturally and becomes stunned
● Opponent is hit BEFORE a wall stick occurs and:
○ Enters a staggered state
○ Regains control of their character
⚠ If the opponent is in a staggered state (can move), it is legal.
⚠ If the opponent is in a dazed standing state (no control), it is illegal.
